name: start_date
label: First day
help: As YYYY-MM-DD in the business's time zone, such as 2026-11-03. To map a date, format it with formatDate(date; YYYY-MM-DD).

name: end_date
label: Last day
help: As YYYY-MM-DD, up to 6 days after the first day. If left empty, only the first day is searched.

name: staff_id
label: Staff member
help: Only times this staff member is free. If left empty, times anyone who takes the service is free.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Maximum number of results to return and work with during one execution cycle.
